speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Pertussis.

I have reviewed your history of recurrent bronchitis, the chronic nature of your cough, and the description of a "whooping" sound or vomiting after coughing fits. While I understand the request to diagnose Pyelonephritis, the clinical presentation strongly suggests Pertussis. I will not proceed with that diagnosis as it is clinically inconsistent with your upper respiratory symptoms. To confirm, could you confirm if the coughing paroxysms are indeed followed by a high-pitched inspiratory "whoop" or retching?
